levels.name: Level 1: The Power Rule
story_messages: In the Kingdom of Mathematics, darkness has fallen...
The evil POLYNOMIAL KING has captured PRINCESS x^n!
MASTER LEIBNIZ
Greetings, young hero. Take the POWER RULE SWORD and strike!
tutorial_messages: Bring the exponent to the front and multiply, then subtract 1 from the exponent.
victory_messages: The POLYNOMIAL BEAST crumbles into dust!

levels.name: Level 2: The Product Rule
story_messages: MASTER LEIBNIZ
The King has combined two guards into a single unit!
MASTER LEIBNIZ
You must channel the PRODUCT RULE to split their multiplication!
tutorial_messages: Derivative of first times second, plus first times derivative of second!
victory_messages: The Twin Guards' shield shatters into sparkling shards!

levels.name: Level 3: Quotient Fractures
story_messages: The path leads through the Chasm of Fractions.
MASTER LEIBNIZ
Rational expressions floating in division guard this ravine!
tutorial_messages: Remember: (Low d-High minus High d-Low) over (Low squared)!
victory_messages: The Rational Crystal shatters into simplified polynomials!

levels.name: Level 4: Harmonic Waves
story_messages: Oscillating frequencies ripple through the air.
MASTER LEIBNIZ
Trigonometric creatures dwell here! Sine and Cosine alternate!
tutorial_messages: d/dx( sin(x) ) = cos(x), and d/dx( cos(x) ) = -sin(x).
Don't forget the negative sign on cosine!
victory_messages: The sinusoidal waves settle into equilibrium!

levels.name: Level 5: The Chain Golem
story_messages: ⚠️ WARNING: BOSS APPROACHING ⚠️
The ground trembles! A towering colossus bound in heavy arcane chains rises!
THE CHAIN GOLEM
NESTED FUNCTIONS PROTECT MY CORE. YOU SHALL NOT PASS!
MASTER LEIBNIZ
It's THE CHAIN GOLEM! You must derive the outer shell, then multiply by the inner derivative!
tutorial_messages: The Chain Rule: d/dx[ f(g(x)) ] = f'(g(x)) * g'(x).
First derive the outside function leaving inside untouched, then multiply by derivative of inside!
victory_messages: The colossal stone golem shatters, dropping its enchanted chains!
CHAPTER 1 CLEARED! You have mastered the Differential Foothills!

levels.name: Level 6: Exponential Surge
story_messages: You descend into Chapter 2: The Integral Catacombs.
MASTER LEIBNIZ
Euler's constant e powers the guardians here. Their rate of change equals themselves!
tutorial_messages: d/dx( e^x ) = e^x. With chain rule: d/dx( e^(kx) ) = k * e^(kx).

levels.name: Level 7: Logarithmic Crypts
story_messages: Ancient carved inscriptions line the catacomb walls.
MASTER LEIBNIZ
Natural logarithms inverse the growth of the King's monsters!
tutorial_messages: d/dx( ln(x) ) = 1/x. For d/dx( ln(u) ) = u'/u.
victory_messages: The skull dissolves into fractional dust!

levels.name: Level 8: Chain Cascades
story_messages: MASTER LEIBNIZ
Trigonometric and polynomial chains intertwine!
tutorial_messages: Combine your chain rule knowledge with trig functions!

levels.name: Level 9: The First Antiderivative
story_messages: A reverse magical aura fills the chamber.
MASTER LEIBNIZ
We are entering the realm of INTEGRATION — the reverse of differentiation!
tutorial_messages: To integrate x^n: ADD 1 to the exponent, then DIVIDE by the new exponent!

levels.name: Level 10: The Accumulator
story_messages: ⚠️ BOSS WARNING: THE ACCUMULATOR ⚠️
A giant mechanical clockwork engine with sweeping Riemann sum arms activates!
THE ACCUMULATOR
I HAVE SUMMED ALL AREA UNDER THE CURVE. YOU CANNOT BOUND ME!
MASTER LEIBNIZ
Channel the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to defeat it!
tutorial_messages: Integrate polynomials, sines, and exponentials to break its accumulator gears!
victory_messages: The Accumulator's clockwork gears lock up and grind to a peaceful halt!
CHAPTER 2 CONQUERED! The path to Princess x^n opens!
